title: FoundryHostConfig
description: Operator tuning for the local job host and CLI host client in .foundry/host.yaml.

base_slack_seconds.description: Fixed socket slack added to every run.advance client call.

per_round_slack_seconds.description: Extra slack per step_budget agent round beyond task timeout.

judgment_max_seconds.description: Override max judgment task timeout (default: max of registry task limits.timeout_seconds).

max_seconds.description: Cap total run.advance client socket timeout.
